name: workflow-manager
description: Quality-first, context-efficient workflow management with daily/work and simple/hard routing, confirmed plans, compaction recovery, and dynamic subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Classify work, gate hard plans, and protect reasoning quality.
interface.longDescription: Keeps daily requests on current settings, requests highest-model assessment for work, solves simple work directly, and requires strict confirmation of detailed hard-work plans while preserving evidence and compaction continuity.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-manager: keep only relevant stages while preserving required reasoning, evidence, correction, and verification.
Correctness and acceptance evidence outrank context savings; checkpoint before compaction and remove only redundancy.
For complex work, optimize expected wall-clock time; delegate positive-utility owned lanes and serialize only real conflicts.
